name: KITTI
description: Car-mounted camera views of road scenes around Karlsruhe, Germany, from the KITTI autonomous-driving benchmark (KIT and TTI Chicago). Recorded with a sensor-equipped station wagon in city, rural, and highway traffic, with vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists labeled under frequent occlusion and truncation. Ultralytics splits the labeled KITTI training images into train and val, omits the unlabeled test set, and drops DontCare regions. Source: Geiger, Lenz, Urtasun, "Are We Ready for Autonomous Driving? The KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite," CVPR 2012; cvlibs.net/datasets/kitti.
